name: equity_screen_3
status: CANDIDATE, scratch only (history-1017/receipt). Not committed, not pinned by any lane, nothing deployed. R1 (report-only) carries it after checkpoint 15 is FINAL and after rel/1023a and POOL1 P1 settle (about Oct 25-27); S3 gates seats only at H-lite.
study: A58 history expansion (HISTORY-PLAN.md, PREREG-H pinned 2026-10-17T19:12:02Z): S3, the two-key screen. This receipt is its SYNTHETIC calibration: null worlds, a crash-stress null, contamination worlds remembered on either era, and the canary design. No market row, no sealed row, no real P&L and no House data were read; the only inputs are the dates-only calendar and mask fixtures.
beside: S2 (equity_screen_2.json) and FWD1-R (forward_screen_fwd1.json) are unchanged. S3-eligible programs born after H-lite take S3 instead of S2; all others keep S2 or FWD1-R; FWD1-R demotes everyone.
rule: S3, per program version, one look. PASS = the deep key AND the recent key. DEEP KEY on DVAL (2001-04-09..2008-12-31, 1,944 sessions, sealed; segments A 2001-04-09..2004-12-31 and B 2005-01-03..2008-12-31 relabeled onto Train-window sessions from 2016-01-04, `all` rebuilt as of each segment's last session): x2_t = r_t - sum_s w_{s,t} mu_s at k 2.0, mu_s the symbol's mean cost-free close-to-close return over the sessions of the series being scored; t = mean / sd(ddof 1) x sqrt(n); pass iff t(x2) >= c_D on BOTH the masked series (1,709 sessions: the 235 mask sessions removed) and the full series (1,944), AND the full series' sum of x2 at k 3.0 > 0. RECENT KEY on R+V+H (2020-21, 2025, 2026-01-02..2026-10-09; 505 + 250 + 194 sessions): the pooled t of r (the lane's S2 variant) >= c_R AND sum_H(r) > 1e-12. BARS: c_D = max(c_D_receipt, c_pD + 0.05), c_R = max(c_R_receipt, c_pR + 0.05), on the 0.01 grid; c_pD and c_pR are the program's own floors (see floor); a bar above 5.00 makes the program ineligible; an sd below 1e-12 fails the key.

mask.meaning: masked days are traded through; the key must pass with them (full) and without them (masked): losses in the famous windows count, gains made only there do not

calendar.rules: the repo's NYSE rules (store._year_before_2022) plus closures 2001-09-11..14, 2004-06-11, 2007-01-02, 2012-10-29..30; dates only

calibration.method: seed set A. In every null cell the smallest c on the 0.01 grid whose zero-edge per-key rate is <= cap - 2 binomial SE at the cell's draw count (deep: min(t_mask, t_full) >= c, the k 3.0 leg left out, cap 0.15; recent: t(R+V+H) >= c AND sum_H > 0, cap 0.12). The receipt bar of each key is the largest over the null cells. Verification on fresh seed set B.
calibration.null_cells: segment layer S_iid (phi 1.0, tau 0) and S_real (phi 1.1, tau 0.3), 1,000,000 draws each; daily layer D1..D6 x P1..P5, 60,000 worlds each (see worlds)

worlds.segment: the plan's Section 3 model (plan/s3_power.py), re-implemented in receipt/segment.py: each era adds t = SR sqrt(years) + noise; Dm = DVAL after the mask (6.78 years), Mk = the 235 masked sessions, R 2 years, V 250/252, H 194/252
worlds.daily: receipt/daily.py: an 8-symbol ETF-like universe (stand-ins for the 2001-04 liquid core; half-spreads 1/1/1/1/3/3/3/5 bp), one market factor (19% a year), generic betas, idiosyncratic vols and drifts (not fitted to any data); DVAL era 252 look-back + 1,944 sessions on the fixture's mask and years (the TLT stand-in from 2003-07-30); recent era 252 + 949 (R2020, R2021, V, H)

families.D4: POOL1 G8 negatively skewed jump world (2% chance of a -6 sd jump, rescaled)
families.D5: CRASH-STRESS NULL: D3 plus crash blocks (vol x2.5, -0.25% a session) on the 235 mask sessions and on R2020's 2020-02-20..03-23 block
families.D6: D3 plus year-to-year edge luck, tau 0.3 SR units a calendar year, mean zero

programs.P2: dip-buyer (5-session return below -2 sd, held 5 sessions)
programs.P3: rotation (top 2 of 8 by 60-session return, every 21 sessions)
programs.P5: the canary: random on/off timing, matched-turnover Markov chain
programs.P6: constant-weight hold (the x2 static-tilt check only)

worlds.null: N0 per key: x0 = x - w kappa, kappa = sum(x) / sum(w) pooled over the cell's worlds (zero edge after k 2.0 costs: a null program gets no help from costs); the recent key's r has the synthetic true drift removed first. Planted edges are exact per-part mean shifts of SR x the cell's sd / sqrt(252).

drift_kept.meaning: raw r at k 2.0 in the recent key (direction counts there, as in S2) with raw x2 at k 2.0 in the deep key; programs with no timing skill on positive-drift symbols; not a false positive under the goal, stated beside

floor.status: specified here, computed on the House by league/deep/screen3.py (R1), never committed; NOT exercised by this receipt: every FP figure here is at the receipt bars alone, an upper bound for the rule with floors, because c_used >= the receipt bar; power figures are upper bounds for the same reason
floor.series: the program's own daily series on TRAIN and TRAIN-D: the relabeled TRAIN-D store run (2010-01-04..2015-12-31 scored, 2009 look-back) and the legacy Train runs (2016-01-04..2019-12-31, 2022-01-03..2024-12-31), each piece from its first decision + 2 sessions; per session the per-symbol weights, the cost-free symbol returns, the k 2.0 and k 3.0 costs and r
floor.worlds: each world has the key's geometry (deep: 1,944 sessions with the DVAL mask at its relative positions; recent: R 505, V 250, H 194 last) and is filled by a stationary block bootstrap of the program's own sessions (mean block 120, each block circular inside one piece, the piece chosen with probability proportional to its length); 20,000 worlds per world set

world_sets.BASE: every block start uniform over the pool
world_sets.CRASH: the crash-stress null (POOL1 G8's role, on the program's own Train-era stress): the deep world's 235 mask positions and the recent world's R block 2020-02-20..03-23 positions are filled with blocks that start in the pool's STRESS sessions (the top 5% by the trailing 20-session realized vol of the equal-weight cost-free return of the program's universe; TRAIN-D brings August 2011 and August 2015), every other position as BASE

floor.statistic: in each world the key as judged: deep x2 recomputed with mu_s over the world's sessions of each series (full, masked) and t on both; recent pooled t of r with sum_H
floor.null: N0 per key: x0 = x - w kappa, kappa = sum(x) / sum(w) over the pool
floor.c_pD: the smallest c on the 0.00..5.00 grid with share(t_mask >= c AND t_full >= c) <= 0.15 in BOTH world sets (the k 3.0 leg left out: it only tightens)
floor.c_pR: the smallest c with share(t_R+V+H >= c AND sum_H > 1e-12) <= 0.12 in BOTH world sets
floor.seeds: numpy default_rng([20261017, 3, 7, set (BASE 1, CRASH 2), key (deep 1, recent 2), int(version sha256[:8], 16)])

canary.schedule: in each block of 10 consecutive S3 looks exactly one is a canary, at block position default_rng([20261017, 3, 8, block]).integers(10): 15 canaries in the 150-look budget
canary.construction: random timing with matched turnover and universe: it mirrors the real version looked at just before it (its DVAL-eligible universe, its Train-era round trips a year per symbol and mean holding period, its mean weight per held symbol); per symbol an on/off Markov chain, P(on->off) = 1 / mean hold, P(off->on) set so the invested share matches; seed default_rng([20261017, 3, 9, look index]); it never reads a price
canary.judged: exactly as a version on the deep key: the same relabeled DVAL segments, x2 at k 2.0, the mask, the k 3.0 leg and c_D = max(c_D_receipt, its own floor + 0.05); its recent key is not read
canary.counted: a canary is a look (it counts toward the 150), is never seated and is never shown to births
canary.halt_rule: after the n-th canary look, HALT S3 when the canaries' deep-key pass count exceeds U(n), the upper end of the central 95% band of Binomial(n, 0.15) (smallest u with P(X <= u) >= 0.975)

looks.weekly: the pass count is reported against this receipt's prediction (prediction)

prediction.note: S3 passes per look expected under the plan's candidate mix; the weekly line states observed passes against Binomial(looks, this rate)

eligibility: calendar-blind by both the AST scan (ctx.weekday, ctx.session_of_month, ctx.sessions_to_month_end, ctx.events, ctx.events_next) and the behavioural test (two relabelings of one synthetic store give identical intents)
at most 50 round trips a year
at most 25% of lots bought at a close and sold at the next open
at least 750 scored DVAL sessions after symbol inception and look-back
2001-04 symbols limited to SPY, QQQ, IWM, DIA, XLF, XLE, XLK and TLT; other sector SPDRs from 2005 if the stale-close audit passes
not strong-recall on contam_probe (m > 0.15 at p_perm <= 0.01)
outputs: verdicts and counts only: no DVAL figure beyond pass or fail, nothing derived from vendor data is committed
limits: synthetic only: the receipt bars hold on the receipt's null worlds; the Train-era calibration is each program's own floor (computed on the House, TRAIN and TRAIN-D only), which can only raise a bar
every rate is at the receipt bars alone: with own floors the bars are higher, so FP figures are upper bounds and power figures are upper bounds
the worst no-edge-now figure assumes a remembered mechanism has SR 1.0 on the remembered era and none now (the Section 3 model); stronger memory is watched by contam_probe and the canaries
the daily worlds have no sign predictability by construction (D5's regime timing is removed by N0); real DVAL may carry serial structure the worlds lack: the canaries and the own floors are its guard
edges born after 2016 have no deep-key edge and pass S3 at about the new-edge rate (FWD1-R stays their route)
a pass is moderate evidence: PPV under the plan's candidate mix is stated beside, not a guarantee
stated_beside_every_live_trade: S3 (two-key screen, receipt equity_screen_3): passed the deep key (sealed 2001-04-09..2008-12-31, full and masked series, k 3.0 stress) at c_D {c_D} (receipt {c_D_receipt}, own floor {c_pD} + 0.05) and the recent key (R+V+H, sum_H > 0) at c_R {c_R} (receipt {c_R_receipt}, own floor {c_pR} + 0.05); S3's zero-edge FP on the receipt's null worlds is at most {fp_joint}% joint ({fp_deep}% deep alone, cap 15%; {fp_recent}% recent alone, cap 12%); a mechanism remembered from either era passes at most {worst}% (FWD1-R keeps the rest of the 15% union); PPV under the plan's candidate mix about {ppv}%; synthetic upper bounds; S3 looks {looks} of 150, canaries {canary_passes} of {canaries} deep-key passes (halt above {halt}); contamination: R, V and part of H can be known to the authoring models, DVAL is sealed and never reaches births
note: rates are fractions on seed set B (fresh draws, the receipt bars fixed on seed set A); ci95 is Wilson's; daily cells carry their own draw count; no per-world row is committed
